citations.excerpt: In 1534 the restraint of annates was confirmed by law, all payments to Rome were forbidden

disagreements.excerpt: The Statute of 1535 (26 Hen. VIII, c. 1) above quoted — it is commonly called the Act of Supremacy which transferred to the king the authority over the Church in England hitherto exercised by the pope

facts.value: Parliament ended papal authority in England and declared the king Supreme Head in earth of the Church of England.

citations.excerpt: The papal power was extirpated by statute
his title as “Supreme Head in earth of the Church of England” was declared by parliament without the qualification added by convocation.
